shared_elements: standing human figure in profile in low relief
radiating linear elements (sun-rays vs. feathered wings)
human hands rendered as small flat forms
field of small incised signs/details on the background
justification: Both surfaces depict human figures in low relief shown in profile with an arm raised, and both include fan-like radiating linear forms (rays descending from a disc in A, layered wing feathers in B), which is the most specific overlap. Otherwise the content is quite different: A is a small scene of slender figures worshipping before an offering table beneath a rayed disc, set above a large panel of inscribed text, whereas B is a single monumental bearded winged figure with heavy musculature filling the whole field with no accompanying scene, text register or interaction between figures.
